verification.name: core.gen.PrimMstInvariantsTest

verification.name: core.gen.PrimIsMinimumSpanningTreeTest
verification.invariant: sum(Prim MST edge costs) == sum(independent Kruskal+DSU MST edge costs) over the same candidate chunk-graph edges

verification.name: core.gen.DeterminismTest
verification.invariant: same seed produces a byte-identical canonical tile-character hash across two independent generate() calls

verification.name: core.gen.WorldConnectivityTest
verification.invariant: every generated room center is reachable from spawn through floor tiles; no null/ragged grid tiles (no out-of-bounds writes)
